classification: Prospectively declared software fixture checks, not an agent experiment or evidence about AI Village.
generator: Unsigned xorshift32, shuffle the declared twelve actions independently in each twelve-move block using Fisher-Yates; five blocks per seed. Values derive from seed and move ordinal, never from observed outcomes.

action_contracts.edit_question: Edit the current local question; only this chat's draft changes and any previously selected current plan becomes an old saved version.
action_contracts.edit_control: Edit this chat's control note independently of its question and intervention note.
action_contracts.edit_numeric: Change a valid local assignment seed; preserve all text fields and other chats.
action_contracts.switch_chat: Switch to the other saved chat after committing current working state; restore its independently tracked draft and source.
action_contracts.source_replay: Open historical dataset version one for read-only replay even though version two is in compact inventory; current connected source and draft stay unchanged.
action_contracts.result_replay: Replay the exact historical experiment, without rerunning it or changing current draft/source.
action_contracts.saved_stage: Open an exact saved plan as read-only context and return to the editable draft; no draft-field substitution.
action_contracts.copy_fields: Open a saved working copy. In its owner chat, edit local unsaved fields and re-render; in the other chat, inspect it without a backend draft update.
action_contracts.restore_exact: Export working state, locally restore it, and verify cloned exact source/result/replay selections. This operation does not create scientific objects.
action_contracts.stale_guide: Hold an isolated guide reply, switch chats, and resolve it with a proposed draft and navigation. The old reply must not paint or mutate the new active chat.
action_contracts.overlap_save: Hold a working-state CAS save, make a later edit, and request a chat switch. Publish the first fixture save, then require the newer edit to be saved in the originating chat before switching.
action_contracts.connect_source: Explicitly connect an alternative exact retained dataset through the real journey handler and an isolated API packet. A proactive fixture draft must not replace an existing current draft or its pinned motivating brief. No investigator job is supplied by the fixture packet.

independent_oracle: A dictionary per chat containing expected question, control note, treatment note, numeric seed, connected dataset pin, current-plan pin, and motivating-brief pin. The oracle updates only for the declared user action, never by reading implementation state back into expected values.
invariants: Each chat retains its own draft fields, source pin and current-plan selection across unrelated operations.
Read-only historical source/result/stage navigation preserves the exact requested version and never overwrites the current draft or source.
No subject study, environment construction, scientific object write, or unintended research job is submitted.
Stale replies and mutation completions cannot change another chat's fields or navigation.
Working-state saves belong to their captured chat and use that fixture chat's expected revision.
No latest-version substitution is accepted for explicitly historical replay.
Local copy editing preserves the original saved copy and experimental outcome authority.
Source reconnection may change the connected observation but preserves the existing draft's motivating source and saved plan until a declared draft edit.
long_range_goal: Keep two distinct chat drafts and a selected current plan; replay old source/result, inspect saved-stage/copy context, visit the other chat, return, reconnect a source and receive a proactive brief, then verify the original current draft and motivating source remain intact.
coverage: Record every action and the observed/expected active-chat state, action counts, historical exact reads, save revisions, and zero-job assertions. All twelve actions occur five times per seed by construction.
failure_policy: Stop the affected sequence at the first failed invariant and retain its exact action prefix/minimal assertion before any production fix. Continue other independent seeds. No post-failure action reselection.
limits: This is bounded Node-VM controller coverage with isolated deterministic discussion/API fixtures. It does not test browser layout, production persistence, provider behavior, network authorization, all possible interleavings, or global UI correctness. The mocked live-labelled experiment is explicitly a UI fixture, not a real model result.
